headline.text: L1 S3 capper bolts loosened by unknown person threw alignment off — *accumulation building*, hand-capping as of 10:44

per_plant_summary.L1: S1 chiller breaker tripped at 21:37, back by 22:24. S3 capper jammed repeatedly on new lid changeover — outfeed sensor failing, bolts discovered loose, hand-capping with accumulation as of 10:44. S4 safety door unlatched at 18:43, cleared in 11 minutes. S2 changeover found five setup misses from previous shift (jaw height, torn belt, missing bins). Flow wrap ran 138 cases short on BUC.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 ran routine. ML3 label tore twice on roll switches, cleared both times inside 4 minutes. FFS film pulled off core on previous shift, documented. Grinding no issues.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 weigh checker belt off at 20:28, fixed by 20:43. TG3 belt shifting after metal detector, down 23:28 to 08:11 for adjustment. TG5 blue belt loose all night, rejecting broken bars, Jose adjusting with no progress as of 06:14. Depositor 4 chocolate sensor buildup caused molds with no deposit at 10:00, cleared by 10:23. Truffle line temper unit cold due to heater breakers tripping, reset at 07:09, product at enrober by 09:24 after reheats. ML1 ran clean after glycol top-up.

notes.text: S1 performed caustic clean at 18:50 after cook times climbed to 47–53 minutes.
S4 kitchen elbow blocked above Conbar at 09:31, cleared, recommended for cleaning checklist.
Theegarten vendor on-site during truffle temper troubleshooting but in meeting.

resolved.title: S1 cook time degradation requiring caustic
resolved.summary: Cook times climbed to 47–53 minutes at 16:41, line ran out of caramel, caustic performed during reheat.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:00 — "Product was in the pack area by 20:00" (Conner Boyd) after caustic finish at 18:50.

resolved.title: S4 safety relay module fault
resolved.summary: Line paused at 18:43 due to safety relay fault.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:54 — "We've have started up again. One of the metal doors under the in-feed belts wasn't fully latched" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: S1 chiller breaker tripped
resolved.summary: Chiller failed at 21:37, breaker tripped, line paused for re-temper.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:24 — "Lines started back up" (Dakota Adair) after breaker reset and re-temper, running at 22:27.

resolved.title: S3 labeler photoeye knocked back
resolved.summary: Labeler feeding labels incorrectly starting 22:27, gap detection photoeye misaligned, line paused twice to pass accumulation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:48 — "The gap detection photoeye for the labels was knocked back slightly" (Caleb York), re-aligned and running.

resolved.title: S2 changeover setup misses from previous shift
resolved.summary: Five setup issues found at 07:49: jaw height wrong (12g vs 24g), infeed rails wrong, belt 7 torn with hoses disconnected, no box labels, no trash bins.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 08:55 — belt replaced, setup corrected, 12g candies and bags found under Matrix 6–8 belts removed.

resolved.title: S4 kitchen elbow blockage above Conbar
resolved.summary: Kitchen stopped at 09:31 due to elbow blockage, PSI had been climbing previous day.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:31 — blockage removed, recommended for cleaning checklist (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: S2 flow wrap shortage for BUC
resolved.summary: Last roll of BUC flow wrap at 10:00, not enough to complete 4.3 pallet target.
resolved.resolution: Documented at 10:28 — "We ended up being 138 cases short due to running out of FW" (Justin Garner).

resolved.title: FFS film pulled off core
resolved.summary: Film came off core when last of roll used up on previous shift, caused downtime.
resolved.resolution: Documented at 07:26 — core info saved for supplier follow-up.

resolved.title: ML3 label tearing on roll switches
resolved.summary: Label broke twice during roll switches, at 15:17 and 21:38, line paused 3–4 minutes each.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:38 — "We already put the label back and the line is up again" after cleaning around break point.

resolved.title: Truffle kitchen temper unit pumps cold
resolved.summary: Riser pump and buffer tank temps low starting 00:23, multiple reheats failed, chocolate exit temp unstable, line down 03:13 to 09:24.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:24 — "Product at the enrober" (Rich Brierley) after Nathan reset heater breakers at 07:09, pumps heating back up.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 1 gondola jam and belt collapse
resolved.summary: Jam in gondola at 01:37 escalated to belt collapse, crew sent to lunch during repair.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:50 — "Has been fixed, ready to run" (Jose Vasquez), depositing again by 02:20.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 4 sensor buildup stopped deposit
resolved.summary: Chocolate buildup on hopper sensor at 10:00 caused line to stop depositing, molds sent through empty, line lead not monitoring.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:23 — "Running" (Itzel Chavez) after sensor clean and flag/reject of empty molds.

resolved.title: ML4 weigh checker stuck open
resolved.summary: Belt came off roller at 20:28, maintenance re-seated and confirmed operation by 20:43.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:43 — "up and running again the belt came off the roller maintenance fixed it operating as should" (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 belt shifting after metal detector
resolved.summary: Belt wandering side-to-side during operation, throwing product, reported at 23:28.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:11 — "Tg 3 is running good now" (Nelson Cook) after overnight adjustments.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 4 temper out of range
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 03:28 when depositor 4 temper climbed out of spec.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:49 — "Depositor emptied, refilled with tempered and purged out air. Line is back up" (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML4 underweight caddies with missing dark filling
resolved.summary: Packaging saw spike in low-weight caddies at 05:04, inspection found bars missing dark chocolate layer.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:14 — operators pulling underweight caddies with 10 bars aside for inspection, no additional found in same pallet (Gina Vazquez).

resolved.title: ML4 demolding mold jam
resolved.summary: Mold jam at demolding section stopped line at 11:44.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:48 — "Area its clean and mold jam it's fixed. Line star running again" (ML4 TG).

resolved.title: ML1 glycol level low
resolved.summary: Glycol reading low at 22:14 during 2nd shift centerline check.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:57 — "Kavin Ayala adjusted Glycol level. It is now at 1.6" (Phillip Perez).

needs_attention.title: S3 capper alignment thrown off by loosened bolts
needs_attention.summary: New lids caused cap trap groove at 06:56, replaced at 09:14 but lids still not sliding consistently, outfeed sensor failing, requires manual no-lid catch. At 09:56 line paused for accumulation. At 10:44 Leon found torque-marked bolts had been loosened by someone, throwing alignment off, adjustments in progress.
needs_attention.status: Line down at 10:44, Leon re-setting alignment after discovering loosened bolts, team hand-capping with accumulation building.

needs_attention.title: S4 caramels with insufficient salt from previous shift
needs_attention.summary: 3rd shift found insufficient salt on caramels at 23:59, checking pallets from 2nd shift.
needs_attention.status: Under investigation at 00:41, checking pallets from previous shift.

needs_attention.title: S3 misprint labels from previous shift
needs_attention.summary: 8 pallets with misprint labels found and placed on hold at 00:19, extent unknown, may be more in Springville from 2nd shift.
needs_attention.status: 8 pallets on hold as of 00:19, checking Springville for additional pallets with misprint.

needs_attention.title: S4 corn syrup cold causing batch timing issue
needs_attention.summary: Cold corn syrup at 20:43 causing 2–3 minute pauses between batches when reserve below 15%, operational timing problem.
needs_attention.status: Ongoing operational issue, no resolution attempted.

needs_attention.title: S4 ingredient stirring tools damaged
needs_attention.summary: Photos at 11:21 show broken stirring tools in totes, cannot stir ingredients properly.
needs_attention.status: Damaged tools shown in photos, no action stated.

needs_attention.title: Truffle separator roller not spinning
needs_attention.summary: Roller not spinning at 21:00, chocolate sticking together, operators using spacers, partial fix by loosening tension and cleaning belt but roller still not moving as of 22:36.
needs_attention.status: Roller still not moving at 22:36, tension loosened and belt cleaned to help straighten, operators using spacers.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 auger mixer overfilled with cookie
needs_attention.summary: Auger mixer stopped at 00:35, causing overfill, crew draining auger out.
needs_attention.status: Draining auger at 00:35, no follow-up on completion.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 blue belt loose, rejecting broken bars
needs_attention.summary: Blue belt lacks tension starting 03:09, causing chocolate spill and jams, Jose adjusting all night with no progress as of 06:14.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance adjusting since 03:09, no improvement by 06:14, rejecting many broken bars.

needs_attention.title: ML1 enrober leak deferred to weekend
needs_attention.summary: Leak minimal at 20:47, no stop needed yet, passed to weekend level 2 cleaning per shift management.
needs_attention.status: Deferred to weekend level 2 cleaning, leak minimal as of 20:47.
